scope: Prospective evidence contract only; sources unchanged, no computation, test, new physical/scientific result or remote issue action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Rise with full payload without rotor or battery authority
entries.existing_model_reference: CLASSES.payloadT/dispM3; ledger local density and dry allowance; loaded-atmosphere classes
entries.units: kg; m3; kg/m3; Pa; K; altitude m MSL
entries.method: Trace actual article mass/displacement and a pressure-temperature-altitude envelope with calibration; compare to the existing loaded-atmosphere record at its named reference, without treating reference offsets as weather.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Actual dry allowance, displacement and weather envelope are unmeasured; historical resize and model capacity tests are not aircraft evidence.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Recharge on solar alone after complete rotor failure and a flat battery
entries.units: W/m2; m2 projected; W; Wh; s
entries.method: Request time-resolved projected-area output and hotel/cold-maintenance load records, battery charge acceptance and usable stored-energy state over the proposed day/night interval.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Day-average and lossless energy quotients cannot establish instantaneous plant operation or a worst-case recovery time.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Accumulate sufficient nitrogen with no rotor authority
entries.existing_model_reference: CFG.eLN2; CLASSES.cryoMW; recovery question #10; question #6 machinery duty limits
entries.units: kg; kg/s; Wh/kg; W; K; Pa; s
entries.method: Request matched plant startup/cold-readiness, flow and energy records with heat-exchanger/support requirements and synchronized bus availability.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Plant ratings and ideal specific energy omit startup, losses and operating compatibility; no production observation supplied.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Retain accumulated ballast throughout the recovery interval
entries.existing_model_reference: CLASSES.ln2CapT; question #9 storage-loss discussion; question #0 distinction between capacity and production
entries.method: Request calibrated tank inventory, thermal/pressure history and loss accounting over the same production interval, including cold readiness and containment state.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Tank geometric capacity does not establish accumulation or retention; no loss criterion or retention trajectory supplied here.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Descend empty and land on ballast alone
entries.existing_model_reference: TERRAIN_MSL; WORK_ALT_MSL; CLASSES.ln2CapT; ledger surplus; historical #0 corrected sizing
entries.method: Request the actual landing elevation and atmosphere, complete empty mass and retained-ballast records along descent; retain ground versus ceiling basis separately.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A ballast record that starts descent at working altitude does not settle arrival at denser ground air; terrain outside the configured reference changes applicability.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Resolve the buildable structural and equipment basis used by sizing
entries.existing_model_reference: Verification plan critical path and E1; mass-budget evidence; current raft/membrane qualification
entries.units: kg; m3 enclosed; packing fraction 1; kg/m3
entries.method: Request an itemized article mass with skin, joints, seals, support and plant inclusions; document architecture and enclosed-volume/packing basis before applying an older sealed-cell budget.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Published literature comparisons and assumed dry allowance have different inclusions; neither validates a drawn hull or current architecture.
